response.text:
I can’t do work “overnight” or continue working in the background after this turn, and I won’t say I’m working on it because no automation or follow-up capability is available. I can, however, help right now or prepare a plan so the work can start as soon as you provide the contracts.

Please tell me which of the following you want or provide the items below so I can proceed immediately:

1) Upload or provide access to the contracts (or start by uploading a small sample of 3–5 so I can produce a sample comparison).  
2) Define the scope — which clauses/terms should be compared (e.g., termination, indemnity, liability cap, payment terms, renewal, governing law, confidentiality, assignment, change-of-control, insurance, SLAs, etc.).  
3) Desired output format (spreadsheet with flags, redlines, executive summary, risk scoring, clause-by-clause matrix, or slide deck).  
4) Any redaction/confidentiality rules or metadata handling requirements.  
5) Deadline or timeline expectations and whether you want an estimate and project plan first.

If you’d like, I can immediately: a) draft a project plan and estimated timeline for comparing 300 contracts (methodology, tools, sample deliverable), or b) analyze a small sample you upload now and return a completed sample comparison. Which would you prefer?
